evals.prompt: Add a lollipop chart that compares the median shadow over the ground of the two scenarios.
evals.expected_output: One node.create of curio.vega-lite/lollipops that gives no content of its own, so the node keeps the template's starter, which reads its column through [!! value !!], and sets its value widget to median, the column of the Shadow over the ground tables; the answer tells the user to connect each scenario's Shadow over the ground node (74e0af5a-c06e-52ae-94ad-94acc2de1642 and ac470b24-69c3-5242-8d07-cc969e868e54) to its own input circle.
assertions: The answer makes one node.create of type curio.vega-lite/lollipops.
The answer sets the chart's value widget to median.
The answer tells the user to connect each scenario's Shadow over the ground node to an input circle of its own on the chart.

evals.prompt: Plan a chart of the two routes' rain exposure against their wind exposure, one point per scenario.
evals.expected_output: A dataflow plan with one node of type curio.vega-lite/points whose x widget is rain_exposure and y widget wind_exposure, wired from both scenarios' metrics nodes (c4a8e1f7-3d6b-4c92-b5e0-8a2d7f1c4b36 and e9b5d3a1-2f8c-4a76-8e1d-4c7b9f0a6e23), one data edge each, with no node that merges them first.
assertions: The answer writes a dataflow plan with a node of type curio.vega-lite/points.
The plan sets the chart's x widget to rain_exposure and its y widget to wind_exposure.
The plan wires c4a8e1f7-3d6b-4c92-b5e0-8a2d7f1c4b36 and e9b5d3a1-2f8c-4a76-8e1d-4c7b9f0a6e23 into the chart, one data edge from each.
The plan adds no node that merges the two metrics tables before the chart.
